messages:
Jordan: Seeing a spike of 502/504s from outbound-pager-proxy to our SMS provider. Customers reporting missed pages. Anyone picking this up?
Aisha: Confirmed — PagerDuty webhooks are being ACKed locally but remote provider times out. Logs show `connection_pool.timeout` + 502s.
ops-bot: :rotating_light: alert: outbound-pager-proxy error_rate > 5% (last 5m). service=pager-proxy env=prod
Samir: I can take this. First check: are pods healthy? `kubectl get pods -l app=pager-proxy -n prod`
Lucy: proxy-1 and proxy-2 are crashing (OOMKilled) repeatedly, proxy-3 is flapping. Restarting proxy-1 now.
Jordan: After restart some pages trickled through but still not all. Customers still seeing delays.
Aisha: Found why incident-bot didn't escalate: our parse logic treats provider body with non-json payload as success. Provider changed response schema yesterday. Bot thought requests succeeded.
Samir: That explains the lack of escalation. I'll patch the response parsing to rely on HTTP status first and add robust JSON try/catch.
Samir: Rolling a hotfix: `kubectl set image deployment/pager-proxy pager-proxy=redwood/pager-proxy:fix/resp-parse`
ops-bot: deploy started by Samir — canary 1/3 pods updated
Lucy: Canary looks good for 90s, rolling to remaining pods.
Jordan: We need manual mitigation while rollout completes. Aisha, can you manually page the unacknowledged incidents and confirm delivery? Use the manual script.
Aisha: On it. Running: 
```bash
python tools/manual_page.py --incidents-file /tmp/unacked_ids.csv --provider twilio
```
Aisha: Manual SMS sent to 4 affected customers, all confirmed receipt (two replied). Posting IDs in thread.
pagerduty-bot: Note: On-call rotation alerted: @oncall-rotation — manual paging initiated by Aisha
Samir: Patch complete. Also added a small retry jitter and lowered connection pool max to avoid retry storm causing OOMs. Will open PR for tests.
Jordan: Quick customer impact summary: delayed or missing pages for ~18 minutes affecting 4 customers. No SLA breach yet but within margin. Recommend CS outreach.
Lucy: Filing incident ticket and pinging #customer-success with a short summary and affected customer list.
Aisha: Added temporary guard in incident-bot to treat parse exceptions as failures so future webhooks trigger escalations.
Samir: Follow-ups: add unit tests for provider parse, e2e staging run against provider sandbox, tune pool sizing.
Jordan: Marking mitigated for now. Keeping channel open for postmortem notes and timeline. (reaction :white_check_mark:)
